# mailcow_mta_sts (Resource)

MTA-STS policy of a domain, served by Mailcow at `https://mta-sts.<domain>/.well-known/mta-sts.txt`. The Mailcow API has no read or delete endpoint for MTA-STS, so the provider reads the public policy page (requested from `host_name` with `Host: mta-sts.<domain>`, no dependency on the domain's own DNS or certificate). That page only exists while the policy is active: the content of an inactive policy can't be read. Destroying the resource deactivates the policy (Mailcow removes it only when the domain is deleted).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mailcow_mta_sts" "example" {
  domain  = "example.com"
  mode    = "enforce"
  mx      = ["mail.example.com"]
  max_age = 604800
}

# Publish the policy id in DNS, e.g. with the Cloudflare provider
resource "cloudflare_dns_record" "mta_sts" {
  zone_id = var.zone_id
  name    = "_mta-sts"
  type    = "TXT"
  content = "v=STSv1; id=${mailcow_mta_sts.example.policy_id};"
  ttl     = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain the policy applies to
- `mx` (List of String) MX hosts allowed by the policy (wildcards like `*.example.com` are allowed)

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether Mailcow serves the policy
- `max_age` (Number) How long senders may cache the policy, in seconds (max 31536000)
- `mode` (String) Policy mode: enforce, testing or none

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `policy_id` (String) Policy id for the `_mta-sts` TXT record (`v=STSv1; id=<policy_id>;`). Generated by the provider (UTC, YYYYMMDDHHMMSS) on create and whenever mode, mx, max_age or active change. Mailcow keeps its own id, which the API doesn't expose, so Mailcow's DNS check page may show a different id; senders only compare the id with the one they cached, so this is harmless.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import id is the domain
terraform import mailcow_mta_sts.example example.com
```
